baleen-plates.context: A whale head seen from the side with its mouth open and a row of comb like plates hanging from the upper jaw. Used for whale biology, filter feeding diagrams, marine science lessons and ocean wildlife guides.

nautilus-shell-section.context: A round spiral shell cut in half, showing a winding wall and short dividers that mark the chambers. Used for marine biology lessons, fossil and natural history museums, and the golden spiral or growth pattern topics.

giant-clam.context: A large clam lying open with deep zigzag shell edges and a wavy mantle showing between the two halves. Used for coral reef guides, aquarium and diving content, seafood and marine life collections.

shark-warning-sign.context: A triangular warning sign on a post showing a shark fin cutting through a wave. Used for beach safety notices, swimming and surf warnings, lifeguard information and shark sighting alerts.

jellyfish-warning-sign.context: A triangular warning sign on a post showing a jellyfish with trailing tentacles. Used for beach safety notices, stinger season warnings, swimming advisories and lifeguard information.
